items: LiFePO4 battery with built-in BMS (12V, 24V or 48V)
why: ChatGPT's answer explains what a built-in BMS does and asks the shopper to pick a voltage (12V, 24V, 48V); it never names a charger, monitor or other item that must be added, so this is a one-battery purchase. The deciding fact is the system voltage and the BMS current rating (for example 100A vs 150A), which a page comparing self-contained batteries like the Redodo, Vatrer and Sun Gold Power models can settle without building a set.
